Multivessel disease in haemodynamically.recommendation: Complete revascularization is recommended either during the index PCI procedure or within 45 days.
It is recommended that PCI of the non-IRA is based on angiographic severity.
Invasive epicardial functional assessment of non-culprit segments of the IRA is not recommended during the index procedure.
In patients presenting with NSTE-ACS and MVD, complete revascularization should be considered, preferably during the index procedure.
Functional invasive evaluation of non-IRA severity during the index procedure may be considered.

General recommendations.recommendation: It is recommended to base the revascularization strategy (IRA PCI, multivessel PCI/CABG) on the patient's clinical status and comorbidities, as well as their disease complexity, according to the principles of management of myocardial revascularization.

Multivessel disease in ACS patients pres.recommendation: IRA-only PCI during the index procedure is recommended.
Staged PCI of non-IRA should be considered.
